entrance: Inside the High Seat of Ironforge, where Magni Bronzebeard sits, a cobwebbed passage opens on the left at /way 43.5 52.0. Follow it all the way down to the portal. The path runs above lava, and a fall is lethal.

96394.objective: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions and 10 Tormented Souls, the ghosts in the first rooms, and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.

shots.alt: Afadra Dunwall in a library full of books, up the stairs from the entrance to the Hall of Thanes

96393.objective: Enter the Hall of Thanes and bring back the head of Durgen Dirgehammer, the final boss.
96393.note: Earthseer Farsen only gives this quest after Underground Map, which starts from the Dark Iron Map that a Dark Iron Spy drops during Nip 'Em in the Bud.

shots.alt: Earthseer Farsen in the snow of Dun Morogh, with the quest window of Old Ironforge Incursion open
The loot window of a Dark Iron Spy with the Dark Iron Map and its tooltip, This Item Begins a Quest

98423.objective: Take the stone tablet from behind a vault door in the Reliquary of Kings, the last room, to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

shots.alt: The tablet of The Treaty of Understanding in a vault of the Reliquary of Kings, with the quest window open

96395.objective: Put the spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar, the first boss, to rest.
96395.note: The one quest of this dungeon that the Horde can do too. The Ghostly Attendant waits in the room before Anvilmar's Rest.

shots.alt: The Ghostly Attendant with the quest window of An Ancient Grudge open, between the ghosts of the first room

96403.objective: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
96403.note: They lie on candle-lit platforms all over the dungeon. The vaults in the Reliquary of Kings hold enough for a group of five.

shots.alt: Thom Filch with the quest window of Important Heirlooms open, just outside the Hall of Thanes
A raised stone platform with candles and Dwarven Heirlooms in a dark corridor of the Hall of Thanes
